## Question

Hypothesis, baseline, candidate alternatives and why a small experiment should precede an expensive build/train cycle.

## Criteria and budget

Predeclared useful improvement, quality loss margin, sample/power rationale, spending/time ceiling and stop conditions.

## Frozen evidence and review

Task/model/provider/adapter versions, evaluation protocol, failure accounting, critical interpretation and promotion decision. Use docs/templates/experiment.md.
